turns.question: What was our net revenue for orders placed in September 2026, meaning order amounts minus the amounts of their returns, excluding cancelled orders?
turns.answer: Net revenue (EUR), defined as revenue minus partner returns (returns counted on the day they were recorded, not matched to the order), was EUR 12,582.75 for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
